themes.title: Electoral Volatility and Internal Friction Facing Right-Wing Parties
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across multiple nations are grappling with significant internal divisions, electoral volatility, and the strategic challenges of governing or campaigning. This includes disagreements over policy within the base, local party controversies, and national shifts in voter support once in power.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Internal disagreements on AI policy and data center development among MAGA supporters; local Republican candidates strategically distance from Trump in midterm races to appeal to local electorates.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Focus on Marine Le Pen's eligibility for future elections and the rising influence of key aides, reflecting internal leadership dynamics and strategic planning for electoral success.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: A local party leader acquitted after internal drama, highlighting grassroots-level friction and its resolution within the party structure.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Experiencing a decline in voter support nationally and locally after taking on governing responsibilities, facing challenges as other parties adopt their key policies.

themes.title: Enduring Influence of Populist Personalities
themes.blurb: The political landscape for the right and far-right continues to be heavily shaped by prominent populist leaders, whose actions, rhetoric, and personal standing profoundly impact their parties' direction and public perception.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump remains the central figure, with extensive coverage of his policy proposals (e.g., AI Force, military arch), foreign policy engagements, and interactions with media and local leaders. His persona drives most narratives.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's legal status is crucial to her 2027 presidential prospects, underscoring her indispensable role as the party's figurehead and electoral draw.

themes.title: Local and Regional Dynamics in Right-Wing Electoral Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties are navigating the interplay between national and local political dynamics, with national figures engaging regional leaders, local candidates adapting their strategies to local issues, and grassroots party structures facing internal challenges.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: President Trump engages with the NYC mayor, signaling attention to urban/local issues; California Republican candidates are seen walking a 'tightrope' by distancing themselves from Trump's national image to appeal to local voters in midterm elections.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: A local party leader's acquittal after a drama highlights the significance of internal disputes and challenges at the regional or municipal level for the national party.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: The party's loss of voter support is noted to be both national and local, indicating that regional accountability and specific local issues play a role in their overall performance.
